name: comp-254
title: Temperature Slider Input
description: A temperature setting that pairs a horizontal slider with a small editable number field. A reset arrow appears once the value changes and reveals a tooltip when hovered.
use: A value needs quick dragging and an exact typed figure, with a one-click way back to its default.
avoid: The scale is fixed at 0 to 2 for thermostat-style values; another range means editing the source.
a11y: Slider, field and reset button all have names, but the invisible reset button stays in the tab order. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The word Temperature sits on the left, followed by a circular arrow icon and a compact rounded box holding a decimal number. Beneath is a grey track with a white filled length and a round white knob.
behaves: Moving the knob updates the field and typing in the field moves the knob. After any change an undo arrow fades in beside the field; hovering it shows Reset to default, and clicking it snaps everything back and the arrow fades out.
customise: The label, minimum, maximum, starting value and default are set in the source; the tooltip wording and decimal step also need edits.
weight: light: One slider, one input and a button; only opacity and position shift.
demo: Label "Temperature"; the value starts at 1.25, climbs to 2 and resets to 1 on a 0 to 2 scale.
issues: The reset button is only faded to zero opacity and remains focusable when it appears hidden.
polishWhy: Tight, coherent spacing and a thoughtful reset affordance; small controls but usable.
